## 0. Card

- **WS-05, scale layer.** Goal: turn WS-04's model (ARKit-scaled in the guided flow, scale-free in the photo flow) into metres with a stated 95 % bound: LiDAR similarity alignment when depth + confidence are present; else the meter's exact make/model cover diameter measured in the two close-ups; ARKit session scale as a gate; doors, garage doors and footprints as consistency checks only; emit the `scale/scale.json` block that WS-06, WS-09 and WS-10 consume, and `scale_unresolved` + a `views_needed` request when the meter cannot be resolved. Accuracy target: scale within 1–2 % (`rel_bound_95 ≤ 0.02` on most houses; plan §1 "criteria need scale within about 1–2 %"; LiDAR branch ≤ 1 % error on the ETH3D stand-in). Photo-flow budget at 26 ft (A10 §1, §3.3, §3.6, `$S/internal/breadth/A10-sparse-photo-flow.md`): ≈ 3 / 7 in median / p90 at true scale on real LaMAR walks; ARKit-only scale on no-depth sessions (+2.3 to +5.5 % on long pairs) costs 6–13 in median on top; the meter make/model term adds ≈ 1.9 / 6.2 in (A9's 0.6 % / 2.0 %, calculated, rescoring pending), so the meter-model estimate is the photo flow's only route to the 2–6 in bar and ARKit-only scale never is.
- Builder model: Grok 4.7. Validator: a separate agent (any model), never the builder.
- Inputs: `poses/cameras.json`, `poses/sparse.ply`, `poses/tracks.npz`, `poses/registration_report.json` (WS-04, SD-03 names); `packet/normalized.json` / `Packet` + extracted packet files (WS-02; LiDAR depth files, `scaleReference`, stills, `streams.arkitPoses`, taps); `reads/reads.json` `meter_identity` + `meter.form` (WS-08's GPT-5.5 + Grok 4.7 read of the `meter_close` still; **WS-05 makes no vision-model call of its own**; `scale` depends on `poses` and `reads`, SD-08); the meter dimension table `data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json` (WS-13 PR-A, read via `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH`); optional `objects/objects.json` meter/door boxes (WS-07, SD-06 shape: `views[].box_px`).
- Outputs (SD-04): `scale/scale.json` (`server.contracts.scale.ScaleBlock` + the additive fields of §3) → WS-06 (applies `scale_factor` about `origin_m`, writes `frame.from_source`, `provenance.scale_source`, copies the block to `scene/scale.json` and mirrors it at `provenance.producer.params.scale`, adds `rel_bound_95 × distance` to every `plus_minus_m`), WS-09 (routing on `rel_bound_95`), WS-10 (`scale {source, status, relBound95}`, `memberActions`, `vn-scale-*` copy); `scale/meter_models.pending.jsonl` (unknown models for WS-13's caliper list); `scale/contour_overlay_<still>.jpg`; `scale/report.json`; diagnostic `sparse_metric.ply` + `cameras_metric.json` with `--emit-metric-copies` (scorer input only, never a pipeline artifact).
- Repo `huntertcarver/house-scanning-server`. Two PRs `[default chosen]`: `ws-05/contracts-scale-ext` (additive optional fields on `ScaleBlock`, reviewed by the WS-00 owner, merged first) then `ws-05/scale-layer`.

## 3. Interfaces

Units: metres for every `_m`, including the meter table (`cover_od_m`, `ring_od_m`, `base_od_m`, `rim_offset_m`, each with a `*_prov` provenance; inches appear only in datasheet citations and in this brief's prose, `IN = 0.0254`); `rel_*` are dimensionless fractions (0.014 = 1.4 %); degrees; pixels continuous `[u, v]`, (0, 0) top-left corner. Frames: `source_frame` is copied from `registration_report.source_frame` (`arkit_world:<epoch>` guided, `colmap_model` photo flow); cameras are camera-to-world 4×4 with ARKit axes (+x right, +y up, looks along −z), loaded from `cameras.json[].pose` with `server.common.geometry.from_column_major`. `scale_factor` = metres per source unit, applied as `x_m = origin + scale_factor × (x − origin)` about `origin_m` (SD-04 name; the point is expressed in source-frame units, which are metres only in the guided flow; mean of the registered camera centres, as housepipe) `[default chosen]`.

Read from the packet (`server.contracts.packet.Packet`; WS-02's `NormalizedPacket` exposes the same names): `session.{tier, deviceModel, lidarAvailable, sceneDepthEnabled}`; `keyframes[].{id, w, h, intrinsics, pose, epoch, depth.{file, confidenceFile, w, h}}`; `stills[].{id, purpose, img, w, h, keyframe, intrinsics}`; `scaleReference.meterCloseUp.{captured, still, arkitDistanceM, viewAngleDeg}`, `.meterIdentity.{make, model, source}` (never persist `rawText`), `.ext.{obliqueCloseUp{…, side}, doorViews[]{frame, kind, box, viewAngleDeg}, doorOnMeterSide, serviceAddress, trueDepthScan{captured, depthDataAccuracy, depthDataQuality, frames[]}}`; `streams.arkitPoses.file` (`t, epoch, tracking, tx, ty, tz, qx, qy, qz, qw, fx, fy, cx, cy`); `taps[]` with `label == "meter"`. From WS-04: `registration_report.{source_frame, lidar_frames, meter.frames, closeups.{meter_close, meter_oblique}.{frame, registered, points3D, reproj_px}, arkit_fit.{rms_m, scale_pct}, actions}`.

`scale/scale.json` = `ScaleBlock` (WS-00 §3.6: `source: meter_model|lidar|arkit|none; model?; scale_factor?; rel_bound_95; status: verified|single_reference|unverified; estimates[]; conflict`) plus these **additive optional fields** (contracts PR, all optional so every existing document stays valid; `origin_m` is the SD-04 name):
```json
{"scale_factor": 1.0132, "origin_m": [0.4, -0.1, -2.3], "source_frame": "arkit_world:e1", "rel_sd": 0.0074,
 "confidence": "tight | standard | near_only | weak | none",
 "reason": null, "reason_detail": null,
 "table_entry": "itron-centron-c1s-poly", "table_version": "1.0.0",
 "arkit_gate": {"available": true, "profile": "nonlidar_modern", "band_pct": 10.0, "residual_pct": -1.9, "passed": true},
 "evidence": {"images": ["s1", "s2", "k00001"], "boxes_px": {"s1": [1200.0, 800.0, 2900.0, 2400.0]}},
 "views_needed": [], "member_actions": [], "timings_s": {"total": 1.8}}
```
`ScaleEstimate` gains optional `method` (`two_view|one_view_rim_offset|walk_frame|lidar_ratio|umeyama`), `view_ids: list[str]`, `pairs: int`, `reason: str`. `estimates[].kind` uses WS-00's vocabulary (`meter_model, meter_generic, arkit_poses, lidar, door_sku, garage_door_sku, footprint, truedepth`); checks always carry `used: false, role: "check"`. `reason ∈ {null, scale_unresolved, scale_conflict}`; `reason_detail` ∈ `lidar_no_depth_files, lidar_too_few_pairs, meter_closeup_missing, meter_closeup_unregistered, meter_model_unread, meter_identity_low_confidence, meter_model_not_in_table, meter_dimension_assumed, meter_contour_ambiguous, scale_reference_edge_not_found, scale_reference_views_disagree, scale_plane_fit_failed, scale_conflict_objects, arkit_gate_fail, no_scale_source` (15 codes: A9 and A8 handoff §7 plus this WS's identity and table codes). `views_needed[]` items are `server.contracts.verdict.ViewNeeded`; `member_actions` values are the result enum `retake_meter_closeups | truedepth_meter_scan`.

Consumers, restated (WS-00 D-04, SD-04): WS-06 applies `scale_factor`/`origin_m`, sets `provenance.scale_source` = `lidar` | `arkit_poses` | `none`, or `scale_reference` with `scale_reference_ids: []` for `meter_model` (the scene enum has no `meter_model` value until the coordinator's spec PR adds it), copies the block to `scene/scale.json`, mirrors it verbatim at `provenance.producer.params.scale`, and adds `rel_bound_95 × distance_from_meter_m` to every element `plus_minus_m`. WS-09 routes on `rel_bound_95` (`> 0.12` → every placement outcome unsure; `> 0.06` → no reject on 16–26 ft reach rules; A9 §9 also asks `opening_clearance`/`under_window` to stay unsure above 0.02) and may read `confidence` as the same tiers. WS-10 copies `{source, status, relBound95}`, `member_actions`, `views_needed`.

## 4. Behaviour spec

1. **Branch.** LiDAR branch iff `session.tier == "arkit_lidar"` and ≥ 1 registered keyframe has `depth.file` and `depth.confidenceFile` of exactly `w×h×4` and `w×h` bytes (`lidar.read_depth`); else meter branch. The meter chain (steps 3–7) runs in both; in the LiDAR branch its estimate is a check (`used: false, role: check`) unless LiDAR fails.
2. **LiDAR alignment** (`align_lidar`, port of `align_scale`): sample ≤ 4000 sparse points (`default_rng(seed)`); per registered camera with depth: `Xc = (xyz − c) @ R`, `z = −Xc[:,2]`, `u = fx·Xc[:,0]/z + cx`, `v = −fy·Xc[:,1]/z + cy`, nearest depth pixel after scaling `w×h → dw×dh`; keep pairs with `inside`, `0.2 < z < 40`, `conf ≥ min_conf`, `0.2 < z_lidar ≤ 5.0`, ratio `r = z_lidar / z` in `(0.5, 2.0)`. First pass `min_conf = 2`; if pairs < 200, retry `min_conf = 1` `[default chosen]`; pairs < 50 → `applied: false`, `reason_detail: lidar_too_few_pairs`, fall through to the meter chain. `scale = median(r)`; `rel_sd = max(0.005, 1.4826 × MAD(log r) / sqrt(n_frames_eff))`, `n_frames_eff` = frames with ≥ 20 pairs (pairs inside one frame are correlated; the 0.5 % floor is the LiDAR's own error, A6: 1.7 cm median within 5 m) `[default chosen]`; `rel_bound_95 = 1.1 × 1.96 × rel_sd` (≥ 0.0108). Report housepipe's old per-point 95th percentile as `pair_spread_p95`, never as the bound. Never mutate WS-04 arrays.
3. **Meter identity (handoff from WS-08).** `meterCloseUp.captured == false` → `meter_closeup_missing`. Otherwise the make/model comes from WS-08's `reads/reads.json`: its early worker runs the `meter_model/v0` prompt (A9's) on the `meter_close` still with GPT-5.5 and Grok 4.7 and writes `meter_identity {manufacturer, model_family, model_evidence, model_confidence, cover_material, ansi_socket_meter, base_flange_visible, socket_type, agree, images}` plus `meter.form`; **WS-05 never calls a vision model and never re-reads the same image** (`VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS` therefore governs WS-05 only through WS-08's output). The same record may arrive earlier as the early-worker blob `captures/{captureId}/early/meter_identity.json` (SD-01, SD-46: WS-08's `read_still` on the `meter_close` still returns the identity and writes that blob; WS-03's `early_reads` calls `server.reads.read_still` only, and WS-05 exposes no `identify_meter` entry point to WS-03; identical field names): `load_meter_identity` accepts either file, preferring `reads/reads.json` when both exist, and looks the identity up in WS-13's table through `server/scale/meter_table.py` (step 4). `load_meter_identity`: no `reads.json`, `status == "disabled"` (`VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=off`), no `meter_identity`, or `model_family: null` → `meter_model_unread`; `model_confidence < identity_min_confidence` (0.5), or `agree == false` with `model_evidence != "printed"` → `meter_identity_low_confidence`; `agree == false` with printed evidence and confidence ≥ 0.5 → proceed, status capped at `single_reference` `[default chosen]`. Both miss codes → `reason: scale_unresolved`, no meter estimate, the step-12 `views_needed` close-up request and `member_actions: ["retake_meter_closeups"]`; WS-03 re-runs the scale stage when a later `reads.json` (amendment or late read) carries an identity. Fallback when WS-08 gave nothing but the packet has `scaleReference.meterIdentity.source == "on_device_text"` with make and model: use it with `source: on_device_text`, `model_confidence 0.5`, status capped at `single_reference` `[default chosen]`. `type_code` = the first table `type_codes` token matched by regex in `model_family` (e.g. `C1SD` in "Itron CENTRON C1SD"). Persist only the record fields above (never `rawText`, never a meter number); `images` become `evidence.images`.
4. **Table lookup** (WS-13's `data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json`, entry shape in `docs/build/ws-13-real-house-and-data.md` §3.3, schema `data/meter-models/meter_models.schema.json`; WS-05 owns only the loader): normalise `manufacturer` and `model_family` (case, punctuation, the tokens `OpenWay`/`II` kept), then match in order `type_code` (a `type_codes` token found by regex in the identity's `model_family`) → `manufacturer + model_family + cover_material` → fuzzy (`difflib.SequenceMatcher(...).ratio() ≥ 0.85` on `manufacturer + model_family`, `match: fuzzy`, `rel_sd × 1.5`). An entry scales only when `usable_for_scale` is true (WS-13 rule: `cover_od_prov ∈ {datasheet, caliper}` and `cover_od_m` numeric). A matched entry whose `cover_od_prov` is `assumed` or `derived` → `meter_dimension_assumed` (only `generic-prior` carries A9's assumed 6.35 / 6.50 / 6.60 in, `usable_for_scale: false`, and no identity ever maps to it); `cover_od_m: null` (`missing`) or no match → `meter_model_not_in_table`. Dual-cover families are two entries sharing `manufacturer + model_family` and differing in `cover_material` (CENTRON poly / glass): material called → weights 0.9/0.1, unknown → 0.5/0.5 `[default chosen]`. Any unresolved code → `reason: scale_unresolved`, **no meter estimate of any kind** (the generic prior is refused), continue with ARKit/LiDAR only, add the `views_needed` close-up request and `member_actions: ["retake_meter_closeups"]`, and append `{manufacturer, model_family, type_code, cover_material, images}` to `out_dir/meter_models.pending.jsonl` for WS-13's caliper list.
   Pinned numbers (A9 handoff §6, Itron CENTRON product sheet dims A/B/G/C, na.itron.com 3803848 / 3803954; stored in metres by WS-13): poly cover 6.29 in = `cover_od_m 0.1598`, glass cover 6.42 in = `0.1631`, rim offset 2.70 in = `rim_offset_m 0.0686` (poly) and 3.03 in = `0.0770` (glass), sealing ring 7.065 in = `ring_od_m 0.1795` (`standard`), S-base 6.95 in = `base_od_m 0.1765` (`datasheet`; ANSI C12.10 via the Itron sheet); Aclara I-210+ overall 6.94 in only (cover `missing`, not scalable); Landis+Gyr FOCUS AX `missing`. The A9 error-budget terms (cover moulding 0.3 %, rim depth SD 0.15 in datasheet / 0.3 in one-view, edge 0.25 %, recon fidelity 0.5 %) are constants in `rim.py`, not table fields. `table_version` is WS-13's semver (`"1.0.0"`; patch = new source for an existing number, minor = new entry, major = schema change), echoed in `scale.json`; the ring/cover, base/cover and ring/base ratios of step 6 are derived from the matched entry's metres, never hard-coded; a pinned unit test guards the six CENTRON values.
5. **Registration.** A close-up counts as registered when `registration_report.closeups.<purpose>.registered == true` (WS-04: ≥ 30 points, reproj ≤ 2 px) and its `frame` is in `cameras.json`. Neither registered → `meter_closeup_unregistered`; then the walk-frame fallback (step 7c) if a meter box ≥ 40 px wide exists in a registered wide frame (tap keyframe or WS-07 box), else no meter estimate and `member_actions: ["retake_meter_closeups"]`.
6. **Contours per registered close-up.** Grayscale, Gaussian σ 1.0 (A8 `refine.gray`); ROI = WS-07 `meter_can`/`electric_meter` box, else the meter tap projected with ±0.5 m at the ARKit distance, else the central 60 % of the frame `[default chosen]`. Candidates: `cv2.Canny(gray, 50, 150)` → `cv2.findContours` → `cv2.fitEllipse` on contours with ≥ 40 points, major axis 25–90 % of the ROI width, `b/a ≥ 0.5`. Refine each: 180 radial rays from the centre, strongest gradient within ±25 px with parabolic sub-pixel (as `refine.snap_edge`), 5-point RANSAC ellipse at 1.5 px, keep `inlier_frac ≥ 0.6` (else that candidate is `scale_reference_edge_not_found`). Label by the matched entry's ratios (`ring_od_m / cover_od_m`, `base_od_m / cover_od_m`, `ring_od_m / base_od_m`; CENTRON poly: `7.065/6.29 = 1.123`, `6.95/6.29 = 1.105`, `1.017`); a pair within `ratio_tol 0.02` labels both. A lone contour is labelled by the ARKit-implied size test (implied diameter under `s_arkit` within 2 × ARKit `rel_sd` of exactly one of cover/ring/base) else `meter_contour_ambiguous`; a lone contour caps status at `single_reference` `[default chosen]`. Write `contour_overlay_<still>.jpg` (A8 `overlay` style, q90, nameplate region blurred).
7. **Cover measurement** (`measure_cover`), `D_table` = the matched cover diameter (or the mixture's hypotheses):
   a. `two_view` (both close-ups registered, both covers labelled): triangulate the circle centre from the two ellipse-centre rays (closest approach; gap > 1 % of the baseline → `scale_reference_views_disagree`); `r0 = a_head × z_head / f_head`; refine `(C, n, r)` with `scipy.optimize.least_squares(loss="soft_l1")` against 72 sampled points of each fitted ellipse; accept if `rms_px ≤ 1.5` and out-of-plane residual ≤ 1 mm at the provisional scale (A9 handoff §7); single-view scales `s_i = D_table / (2 a_i z_i / f_i)` must agree within 1 % else `scale_reference_views_disagree` → 7b with `rel_sd = 0.03` and `member_actions: ["retake_meter_closeups"]`. `scale = D_table / (2 r)`; `rel_sd = sqrt(0.003² + (0.15 in / 39 in)² + 0.0025² + 0.005²) = 0.0074` (A9 budget: moulding, rim depth, edge, recon fidelity); view angles `acos(b/a)` must give head-on ≤ 30° and oblique 15–50° (spec §6) else warn `closeup_angle_out_of_spec`.
   b. `one_view_rim_offset` (one registered close-up, `rim_offset_in` from a datasheet): wall depth `z_w` from a RANSAC plane on the per-image track points in a band around the ROI (`fit_plane` threshold 0.4 % of median depth, front-most point per 8 px cell, A8 `measure_segment`; < 8 points → `scale_plane_fit_failed`); closed form `scale = (D_table × f / (2 a) + rim_offset_m) / z_w`; `rel_sd = sqrt(0.003² + (0.3/39)² + 0.0025² + 0.005²) = 0.0099`.
   c. `walk_frame` (no close-up registered): cover ellipse in the widest registered frame showing the meter (≥ 40 px), labelled by step 6, depth from the wall plane; `rel_sd = 0.03` (A8 "meter from a house photo"); status ≤ `unverified`.
8. **ARKit gate** (`arkit_gate`): Umeyama (`server.common.geometry.umeyama`) of registered SfM camera centres onto the ARKit centres of the same keyframes and epoch → `s_arkit_per_source` (≈ 1 with priors; equals WS-04's `arkit_fit.scale_pct` when present). Profile from `session.deviceModel`: `arkit_lidar` tier → `lidar_modern` `rel_sd 0.011`; `iPhone13,*` and later → `nonlidar_modern` `rel_sd 0.03`; older → `nonlidar_2018` `rel_sd 0.10` (packetgen `profiles.json`; A6 real: 1.2 % median / 2.8 % p90 whole-session) `[default chosen]`. `residual_pct = 100 × (scale_factor / s_arkit_per_source − 1)`; `passed` iff `|residual_pct| ≤ band` (10 % modern/LiDAR, 30 % = 3 × SD for 2018). Not passed → `arkit_gate_fail`, `status: unverified`, `member_actions: ["retake_meter_closeups"]`. No ARKit poses → `available: false`, status ≤ `single_reference`.
9. **Fusion** (`fuse.py`, port of A9 `Src.loglik`/`fuse`): posterior over log-scale on `GRID` from the `used: true` sources: LiDAR (Gaussian, step 2 `rel_sd`) or meter (Gaussian; a mixture with `offsets = log(D_i / D_ref)` and the table weights when two covers remain), ARKit (Student-t ν 4, its `rel_sd`), TrueDepth (Gaussian `rel_sd 0.015`; only when `captured`, `depthDataAccuracy == "absolute"`, `depthDataQuality == "high"`, ≥ 10 frames; diameter = cover ellipse major axis × median TrueDepth depth over the cover / f `[default chosen]`); `EPS_OUT = 0.03`. `scale_factor = s_ref × exp(median)`, `rel_bound_95 = 1.1 × (exp(hi) − exp(lo)) / 2`, `rel_sd = rel_bound_95 / (1.1 × 1.96)`. No metric source → ARKit-only posterior (a single Student-t source gives `rel_bound_95 ≈ 1.1 × 2.78 × rel_sd`: ≈ 0.09 modern, ≈ 0.30 for 2018; `source: arkit`); nothing at all → `source: none`, `scale_factor: null`, `rel_bound_95: 1.0`, `confidence: none`, `no_scale_source`.
10. **Checks** (never `used: true`, never move the estimate): entry-door leaf from `ext.doorViews[] kind == entry_door` (A8 edge snap of the two vertical leaf edges, `line_separation` on the wall plane; mixture offsets `log(80/{80,78,84,96})`, weights `[0.80, 0.05, 0.10, 0.05]`, `rel_sd 0.016`; the outline-vs-leaf +4–9 % risk is why it stays a check); garage door from `kind == garage_door` (A9 `garage()` SKUs by aspect ratio, `meas_sd 0.01`, `aspect_sd 0.014`); footprint disabled in v1 (`estimates[] {kind: footprint, used: false, reason: "disabled"}`) `[default chosen]`; brick and siding not implemented (A8 dead end). Checks posterior = `fuse(ARKit + checks)`; `conflict = checks.bound_95 < 0.04 and |anchor.log_est − checks.log_est| > 3 × hypot(anchor.bound_95 / 2, checks.bound_95 / 2)` (A9 rule; fires on ~2 % of simulated houses). Conflict → `conflict: true`, `reason: scale_conflict`, `reason_detail: scale_conflict_objects`, `rel_bound_95 = max(anchor.bound_95, |Δ|)`, `status: unverified`, `member_actions: ["retake_meter_closeups"]`.
11. **Status** (`block.py`): `verified` iff LiDAR (`pairs ≥ 200`, `frames ≥ 5`, `rel_bound_95 ≤ 0.02`, gate passed or unavailable, no conflict) or meter (`params.meter_verified_enabled`, provenance `datasheet|caliper`, method `two_view|one_view_rim_offset`, identity `agree: true` with `source: reads`, no lone contour, gate available and passed, no conflict). `single_reference`: a metric source without a passed gate, or a lone contour, or identity `agree: false` / `source: on_device_text`, or `meter_verified_enabled == false`. `unverified`: everything else (ARKit-only, walk-frame, conflict, gate fail, unresolved, none). `confidence` from `rel_bound_95`: ≤ 0.015 `tight`, ≤ 0.02 `standard`, ≤ 0.06 `near_only`, ≤ 0.12 `weak`, else `none` (A9 §9 routing) `[default chosen]`. Size-based references and ARKit never yield `verified`.
12. **Requests.** Unresolved, unregistered, conflict or gate fail → `views_needed: [{"id": "vn-scale-1", "kind": "close_up", "target": "meter close-up: whole cover and nameplate, head-on from about 3 ft, then once more from about 30 degrees to the side", "criteria": ["scale"], "why": "<reason_detail>"}]` and `member_actions: ["retake_meter_closeups"]`; meter known, registered, gate passed but `rel_bound_95 > 0.02` → `member_actions: ["truedepth_meter_scan"]` (A9 §9). Never a tape or any tool.
13. **Amendments** (`parentPacketId` set): WS-04 registers the new close-ups into the first model; WS-05 re-runs on the union with the newest `reads.json` (WS-08 re-reads the new `meter_close`).
14. **Determinism.** Contours, fusion and LiDAR use fixed seeds; the only non-deterministic input (the VLM read) is WS-08's and arrives as a file; every WS-05 test replays fixed `reads.json` fixtures, so two runs on the same inputs are byte-identical apart from `timings_s`.
15. **Budget.** `run_scale` ≤ 30 s CPU (electro: LiDAR align < 5 s, contours < 2 s, fusion < 10 ms), no network, no GPU; every failure degrades to a valid block, the stage never raises for a missing or bad scale source; `ScaleError(code)` only for `packet_field_missing:<name>`, `poses_artifact_missing:<name>`.

## 5. Reuse

Read fully first: `$S/internal/context-dumps/full/a9-no-tape-scale.md` (§1 measured vs simulated, §6 dimension entries on hand, §7 integration notes with the two-view method and error codes, §8 risks) and `$S/internal/context-dumps/full/a8-scale-without-lidar.md` (§4 snap/plane/combination parameters, §5 dead ends incl. `full_matrices=False`, §7 integration notes). Both say nothing is in the repo yet. A9 §1/§8: **the whole meter scale term is simulated** (registration 85/95 %, rim-depth SD 0.3/0.15 in, contour confusion 3 %, table coverage 90 %), the two-view rim measurement is "modelled only; not implemented", only Itron CENTRON has published cover diameters, and the 6.35/6.50/6.60 covers are assumed. So `contour.py`, `rim.py` and `meter_table.py` are new code validated by §8 item 8; the table data itself is WS-13's (`data/meter-models/`, per-number provenance, `caliper` rows after capture day); the A8 primitives and the A9 fusion are the only ports.

- Port and adapt: `$S/internal/modal-pipeline/housepipe/lidar.py` (already vendored as `server/scale/lidar.py`): `frame_depth_spec`, `has_lidar`, `read_depth`, `load_depths`, `_sample`, `align_scale` → pure `align_lidar`, `_scale_about` + `scale_pose` → `apply.scale_about`; keep the projection maths and the 0.5–2.0 ratio gate; drop in-place mutation and the per-point `rel_bound_95`. `server/common/geometry.py` (= `housepipe/geometry.py`): `umeyama`, `from_column_major`, `column_major`, `colmap_to_arkit_pose`.
- Not ported here: `$S/internal/breadth/a9-no-tape/meter_model.py:PROMPT` and `$S/internal/breadth/b2/vlm.py` are WS-08's (`meter_model/v0`, `docs/build/ws-08-meter-panel-reads.md` §4 steps 3–5 and 8); WS-05 consumes the resulting `meter_identity` record. Reuse from A9 for tests only: `results/meter_model_gpt-5.5.jsonl` (22 real answers, no digit runs) and `results/meter_model_check.csv` (truth).
- `$S/internal/breadth/a9-no-tape/no_tape_mc.py`: `Src`, `fuse`, `GRID`, `EPS_OUT`, `meter()`, `door_leaf()`, `typed()`, `garage()`, the recommended-policy conflict rule (lines 386–407) → `fuse.py`, `checks.py`, `sim/no_tape_mc.py`; `$S/internal/breadth/a8-scale/combine.py`: `arkit_draws`, `mdepth_draws`, `recon_term`, `meter`, `robust_combine`, `conflict`, `summarise` → `sim/a8_terms.py` reading the copied JSON fixtures (drop `common`/`pycolmap`; keep seed 7 and the draw order or the numbers move ~0.1 pt, A9 handoff §3).
- `$S/internal/breadth/a8-scale/refine.py`: `snap_edge` (radial variant), `intersect`, `overlay`; `common.py`: `fit_plane` (`full_matrices=False`), `segment_band`, `ray_plane`, `measure_segment`, `line_separation`, `sim3`; `measure.py`: `view_tracks` → per-image tracks from WS-04's `tracks.npz`.
- Reference only: `a9-no-tape/c1_scale_sweep.py:BoundPerturber`, `analyze_c1.py` (WS-09's sweep), `a8-scale/results/no_tape_mc.md`, `c1_scale_summary.md`.
- Drop: tape terms (`tape()`, re-measure prompts; no customer tools), learned depth as a source (A8 §3.3 ±20 %), brick/siding counting (A8 dead end: ≥ 20 px per unit), symmetric object fusion (barn −9.7 % with a 1.3 % bound), World Labs. ## 7. Commands

```bash
uv sync --frozen && make fixtures ONLY=all && make gt            # WS-00 targets; CPU laptop; no API key needed
export HSS_SCALE_METER_VERIFIED_ENABLED=0 HSS_SCALE_ALLOW_ASSUMED_DIMENSIONS=0 VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=on   # defaults, shown for clarity (SD-11)
export HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH=data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json                   # WS-13's table; the §1 item 5 seed until PR-A lands
uv run python scripts/meter_models/validate_table.py "$HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH"          # WS-13's validator, < 1 s, exit 0
tar -xf .fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro.tar -C .fixtures/packets/                      # → .fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro/
uv run python -m server.poses.run --packet .fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro/packet.arkit-lidar.json --out runs/electro/arkit-lidar   # WS-04, or the §1 stand-in
uv run python -m server.scale.run --packet .fixtures/packets/eth3d-electro/packet.arkit-lidar.json \
    --poses runs/electro/arkit-lidar/poses --reads runs/electro/reads/reads.json --out runs/electro/arkit-lidar/scale --emit-metric-copies   # < 5 s CPU; --reads optional
uv run python -m server.scale.validate runs/electro/arkit-lidar/scale/scale.json                      # ScaleBlock + ext schema, exit 0
uv run python -m server.eval.cli score-cloud --gt data/fixtures/scenes/eth3d-electro/gt-laser/scene.json \
    --cloud runs/electro/arkit-lidar/scale/sparse_metric.ply --cameras runs/electro/arkit-lidar/scale/cameras_metric.json \
    --metric --producer ws05-lidar --out runs/electro/arkit-lidar/score          # 2–12 min CPU; read scale.scale_error_pct
uv run pytest server/scale/tests -q                                             # < 3 min CPU (MC at N=2000)
uv run python -m server.scale.sim.no_tape_mc --n 20000 --out runs/mc            # ≈ 3.5 min on 4 vCPU
uv run python -m server.scale.run --packet <p> --poses <d> --reads server/scale/tests/fixtures/reads/m28.reads.json --out runs/identity-m28   # identity handoff replay
uv run python -m server.scale.run --packet data/fixtures/packets/mini-arkit/packet.json --poses /tmp/ws04/mini/poses \
    --reads server/scale/tests/fixtures/reads/m28.reads.json --out runs/mini/scale                                   # §8 item 13 (SD-43: packet.json, never a glob)
uv run python -m server.scale.rim --experiment internal/ws05-experiment/manifest.json --out runs/experiment   # §8 item 8
make lint && make hygiene && uv run lint-imports
```

## 8. Done when

1. `uv run pytest server/scale/tests -q` green with no network (a test monkeypatches `socket.socket` to raise, as WS-08 does); the status logic is covered for all 15 `reason_detail` codes (parametrised) and `verified` is proven impossible when `arkit_gate.available == false`, when only checks exist, when the identity is `on_device_text` or `agree: false`, or when `meter_verified_enabled == false`.
2. LiDAR, electro `arkit-lidar`: `source == "lidar"`, `pairs ≥ 200`, `frames ≥ 5`, `status ∈ {verified, single_reference}`, and `score-cloud --metric` reports `scale.scale_error_pct` and `scale.alignment.cloud_scale_error_pct` both within ±1.0 on the emitted metric copies. Facade `arkit-lidar`: the same when `pairs ≥ 200`, otherwise `applied: false` with `lidar_too_few_pairs` and a valid fallthrough block (record which happened).
3. Synthetic LiDAR recovery: rescale electro's SfM by 0.85 and by 1.15 before `align_lidar`; `scale_factor × k` agrees with the unscaled result within ±0.5 %.
4. Fallthrough: `arkit-nonlidar` → `source arkit`, `status unverified`, `reason scale_unresolved`, `reason_detail meter_closeup_missing`, `rel_bound_95 ∈ [0.08, 0.11]` (modern) / `[0.25, 0.33]` (2018), `views_needed[0].kind == "close_up"`, `member_actions == ["retake_meter_closeups"]`; `pose-free` → `source none`, `scale_factor null`, `confidence none`, `no_scale_source`. Every block passes `server.scale.validate`.
5. Identity handoff: on the 22 replayed `reads.json` stubs `lookup` returns a CENTRON entry for m28 and m39 only (m28 with the 0.5/0.5 glass/poly mixture, `cover_material` unknown) and `meter_model_not_in_table` for every other record (no wrong hit); the `disabled`, `no_identity` and `low_confidence` (`model_confidence 0.4`) stubs give `reason: scale_unresolved` with `reason_detail` `meter_model_unread`, `meter_model_unread`, `meter_identity_low_confidence`, each with the `vn-scale-1` `close_up` request and `member_actions == ["retake_meter_closeups"]`; `agree_false_printed` proceeds with status ≤ `single_reference`; `on_device_only` proceeds with `source: on_device_text`, status ≤ `single_reference`.
6. Table: `MeterTable.load` accepts the file `scripts/meter_models/validate_table.py` accepts and rejects one it rejects (a `*_m` without `*_prov`); `lookup(..., allow_assumed=False)` refuses every `usable_for_scale: false` entry (`generic-prior` → `meter_dimension_assumed`, `cover_od_m: null` → `meter_model_not_in_table`); the CENTRON metres `0.1598 / 0.1631 / 0.0686 / 0.0770 / 0.1765 / 0.1795` (6.29 / 6.42 / 2.70 / 3.03 / 6.95 / 7.065 in) are pinned; `table_version` from the file is echoed in every `scale.json`.
7. Synthetic contour + rim: 20/20 seeds label cover/ring/base correctly; Ø error ≤ 0.5 % (`two_view`) and ≤ 1.0 % (`one_view_rim_offset`); ring-only render → `meter_contour_ambiguous` unless the ARKit-size test resolves it; the 31° view passes the 15–50° check and 6.5° the ≤ 30° check.
8. **Meter measurement experiment (real photos; nothing in A9 was measured on a real meter).** ≥ 3 real ANSI socket meters (team members' or Base field team's, never customers'), each with cover, ring and base diameters caliper-measured by the team and the camera-to-cover distance laser- or tape-measured by the team (team tools are fine; the no-tool rule applies to customers); per meter: head-on and ~30° close-ups at 0.6, 0.9 and 1.2 m on an iPhone (guided app if available, else stills with EXIF intrinsics). Run `contour.py` + `rim.py` with `--known-distance-m` standing in for SfM depth, and the full `two_view` path where an ARKit or COLMAP walk-up exists. Report per photo: labels vs truth, Ø error %, `two_view` vs `one_view_rim_offset`. Targets: labels right ≥ 95 %; Ø error ≤ 1.0 % median and ≤ 2.0 % p90 at 0.9 m; `two_view` within 1 % of `one_view_rim_offset`. File `$S/internal/build/validation/ws-05-meter-experiment.md`; photos stay on the bucket/VM (they show meter numbers); committed overlays have the plate blurred. Until this passes, `meter_verified_enabled` stays `False` and meter-sourced scale caps at `single_reference`.
9. MC reproduction (`sim/no_tape_mc.py`, N = 20000, seed 7): row "Two meter close-ups (head-on + ~30 deg), exact model (+ARKit modern)" = 0.6 / 2.0 / 3.1 % ± 0.1 pt; the two-close-up recommended-policy row 0.6 / 2.0 / 3.1 % with `conflict_rate` 0.02 ± 0.01; "ARKit modern only" 2.4 / 5.7 / 6.9 %; tape reference 0.4 / 1.0 / 1.2 %.
10. Regression gates stay green: `make validate`, `make schemas` (`export_schemas --check` after the contracts PR), `make hygiene`, `uv run lint-imports`, and `score-verdicts` on the reference verdicts reporting 0 unsafe passes (WS-05 changes no verdict; re-run after WS-06/09 consume the block).
11. Runtime: `report.json` shows `total_s ≤ 30` on electro; `rg -n "openai|xai|httpx|requests" server/scale --glob '!tests/**'` is empty (no VLM client, no network in this WS).
12. Hygiene: `git ls-files server/scale | xargs du -b | awk '$1 > 5000000'` empty; `rg -n "[0-9]{6,}" server/scale/tests/fixtures/` lists nothing but justified sizes/hashes; no `rawText`, no meter number, no Base SSR text, no copy of `meter_manifest.csv` anywhere under `server/scale`; `rg -n "meter_models" server/scale --glob '!tests/**'` shows only the `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH` default (no second table).
13. `mini-arkit` run (§7) with the `m28` replayed `reads.json`: valid block, `meter.source` path taken (`closeups` read from WS-04's report), `reason_detail ∈ {scale_reference_edge_not_found, meter_closeup_unregistered}`, `views_needed[0].id == "vn-scale-1"`, `member_actions == ["retake_meter_closeups"]`.

## 9. Validator checklist

Fresh clone, own environment; run §7 yourself on electro `arkit-lidar`, `arkit-nonlidar`, `pose-free` and paste each `scale.json` and the `score-cloud` `scale` block into `$S/internal/build/validation/ws-05.md` (frontmatter per the brief-template rule; sections: environment, commands + exit codes, table item/command/expected/observed/pass-fail for §8 items 1–12, hand checks, defects).
1. Assert §8 items 2–7 and 9 numerically from your own runs, not the builder's tables.
2. Open 3 `contour_overlay_*.jpg` (2 synthetic, 1 from the experiment if it ran): labelled ellipses sit on the cover and ring edges, the plate is blurred.
3. Inspect the table WS-05 read (`data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json`, or the seed when PR-A is not merged): every `usable_for_scale: false` entry is refused by a live `lookup` call; `source.url` and `accessed` present on every non-caliper, non-missing number; `table_version` echoed in each `scale.json`; no table file under `server/scale/` outside `tests/fixtures/`.
4. `rg -n '"used": *[Tt]rue' server/scale` next to `door|garage|footprint|brick|siding` → none; force `arkit_gate.available = False` in a unit test and confirm `status != "verified"`.
5. `rg -n -i "tape|measure the|ruler" server/scale --glob '!tests/**'` → only the constraint comments; `member_actions` values ⊂ `{retake_meter_closeups, truedepth_meter_scan}`.
6. No model calls: `rg -n "OPENAI_API_KEY|XAI_API_KEY|openai|x.ai" server/scale` is empty; run the electro fixture with `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=off` and a `reads.json` of `status: "disabled"` → `meter_model_unread`, a valid block, no socket opened.
7. Item 8: if the experiment did not run, the report says so, `meter_verified_enabled` defaults to `False`, and no fixture block shows `source == "meter_model"` with `status == "verified"`.
8. Fail the WS if any §8 threshold is missed, any artifact is missing, any `assumed` dimension can scale, or a number in the PR does not reproduce.

## 10. Constraints

- Vision models GPT-5.5 and Grok 4.7 only, no Anthropic: the make/model read is WS-08's pair on the `meter_close` still, governed by `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS`; WS-05 itself makes no model call, opens no socket and needs no key.
- Never commit real meter numbers, `rawText`, Base SSR prompt text, API keys, customer photos or any file over 5 MB; `meter_models.pending.jsonl` holds manufacturer/model/type/material/still id only; `make hygiene` runs on every PR.
- No customer tools in any capture assumption: the app supplies two close-ups and an optional TrueDepth scan; calipers and a laser/tape appear only in the team-run §8 experiment.
- Cost caps: VLM spend $0 in this WS (WS-08 pays ≈ $0.045 per house for the make/model pair); no GPU; Modal spend ≤ $5 (the §1 stand-in run), stop and report at $4.
- Privacy: WS-05 sends nothing off the server; it reads WS-08's record and the packet files; overlays blur the plate; image bytes are never logged.
- Safety invariant: an unresolved, unregistered or conflicting scale widens bounds, never narrows them; ARKit alone, size-based references and `assumed` dimensions can never produce `verified`.

## 11. Out of scope and handoffs

- WS-04: registering close-ups (bridge photos), `registration_report.closeups`, fragment policy, the early `retake_meter_closeups` action; WS-05 reads, never rescales WS-04's files.
- WS-06: applying `scale_factor`/origin (`apply.scale_about`), `frame.from_source`, `provenance.scale_source`/`scale_reference_ids`, `plus_minus_m += rel_bound_95 × distance`, LiDAR fusion (`lidar.fuse`, `far_points`, `coverage_depths` move there later).
- WS-07: meter/door/garage boxes (`objects/objects.json`, SD-06: `objects[].views[].box_px` per image; `objects` runs in parallel with `poses`, so the file may be absent when `scale` runs); WS-05 falls back to taps and the app's `doorViews` boxes.
- WS-08: the make/model read (`meter_model/v0` on `meter_close`, GPT-5.5 + Grok 4.7) delivered as `reads.json` `meter_identity` + `meter.form` and, early, as `captures/{captureId}/early/meter_identity.json` written by `read_still` (SD-46), plus meter number, class label and panel reads (never in WS-05). WS-03: runs the scale stage after `poses` and `reads`, calls only `server.reads.read_still` in the early path (no WS-05 entry point, SD-46), and re-runs `scale` when a later `reads.json` (late read or amendment) carries an identity the first run lacked.
- WS-09: routing on `rel_bound_95` (0.06, 0.12; A9's 0.02 rule for `opening_clearance`/`under_window`), `unsure_cause: margin` with `bound_breakdown`.
- WS-10: `scale {source, status, relBound95}`, `memberActions`, customer copy for `vn-scale-*`. WS-12: env plumbing for `HSS_SCALE_*` and `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS`; `data/meter-models/` copied into the pipeline image.
- WS-13: the meter table data, schema and validator (`data/meter-models/`, `scripts/meter_models/`, `TARGET_MODELS.md`, `SOURCES.md`, `caliper-protocol.md`; `caliper` rows for R1/R2 and Base's ~15 models; provenance per number), the real non-Pro house capture with truth, `nonlidar_modern` recalibration, the TrueDepth outdoor test; WS-13 consumes `scale/meter_models.pending.jsonl`.
- WS-00/WS-14: the spec PR that adds `meter_model` to `provenance.scale_source` in `docs/scene-and-verdict-format.md` (seam decisions §9 item 2); contract review of `ws-05/contracts-scale-ext`.

## 12. Open questions and defaults

| Question | Default until answered |
|---|---|
| Fields beyond WS-00's `ScaleBlock` (scale factor, origin, reason codes, gate, evidence, requests) | additive optional fields via `ws-05/contracts-scale-ext`; `scale.json` stays valid for readers that know only `ScaleBlock` |
| `rel_bound_95` (artifacts) vs `relBound95` (result API) | snake_case in `scale.json`; WS-10 maps |
| Base dimension table | WS-13's `data/meter-models/meter_models.v1.json` (D2 of `layout-decisions-ws-13.md`): datasheet entries only at v1, so only Itron CENTRON scales today (WS-13 expects 3–8 `usable_for_scale` entries after its research); everything else is `scale_unresolved` with a retake request and a `meter_models.pending.jsonl` row; Base's census + WS-13 calipers raise coverage |
| Customer photos to OpenAI/xAI (Base decision 8) | WS-08's call; WS-05 sends nothing; with `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS=off` every meter-sourced scale is `scale_unresolved` |
| Env-var convention | `HSS_SCALE_*` (SD-11) plus the shared bare `VISION_EXTERNAL_CALLS`; `HSS_SCALE_METER_MODELS_PATH` for the table |
| Golden packets have `stills: null` (queue, cross-cutting) | `mini-arkit` (SD-29) exercises the field paths; the meter measurement itself is validated on synthetic renders and the §8 item 8 experiment |
| `identity_min_confidence` | 0.5 on WS-08's `model_confidence` (GPT-5.5 answered 0.9–0.96 on printed plates in A9's 22); tune on WS-13's real captures |
| ARKit profile by device | `iPhone13,*`+ → modern 3 %; older → 2018 10 %; LiDAR tier 1.1 % |
| Gate band | 10 % (plan); the A9 handoff's "3 × 10 %" read as the 2018 profile's 3 σ → 30 % there |
| Footprint check (address lookup) | disabled (hosted-architecture: footprint skipped for now); interface stubbed |
| TrueDepth fusion | only `absolute` + `high` quality, `rel_sd 0.015`; otherwise recorded, unused; WS-13 tests it outdoors |
| `confidence` tiers | 0.015 / 0.02 / 0.06 / 0.12 mirror A9 routing; WS-09 keeps reading `rel_bound_95` numerically |
| WS-08 reports `agree: false` on the identity | proceed only with printed evidence and confidence ≥ 0.5, status capped at `single_reference`; else `meter_identity_low_confidence` |
| WS-08 gave nothing but the packet carries on-device text | use `scaleReference.meterIdentity` as `source: on_device_text`, confidence 0.5, cap `single_reference` |
| Lone contour | resolve by ARKit-implied size within 2 × ARKit SD, else `meter_contour_ambiguous`; cap `single_reference` |
| `eth3d-delivery` packet missing | LiDAR gate on electro (mandatory) and facade (if pairs) |
| WS-04 artifact names | resolved (SD-03): `poses/cameras.json`, `poses/sparse.ply`, `poses/tracks.npz`, `poses/registration_report.json`, `poses/sparse/0/`; WS-00 §3.9 carries the same names |
| `origin_source_units` vs `origin_m` | `origin_m` (SD-04), documented as source-frame units |
| `scale_reference_ids` for meter-model scale (`["meter.cover_dia"]` vs `[]`) | `[]` with `scale_source: scale_reference` (WS-00 D-04) until the spec PR adds `meter_model` to the enum |
